description: This file defines message identifiers and a helper class for diagnostic messages related to RTF rendering in the MigraDoc document creation library. It includes an enumeration of message IDs and a class with static methods to generate messages for various error conditions encountered during RTF rendering.

classes.name: MdRtfMsgs
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods to generate diagnostic messages associated with RTF rendering errors.

methods.name: TextFrameContentsNotTurned
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that text-frame contents could not be turned, with a restriction to paragraphs within text-frames.

methods.name: ImageFreelyPlacedInWrongContext
methods.description: Returns a message that an image placed outside allowed contexts is ignored, including the image name.

methods.name: ChartFreelyPlacedInWrongContext
methods.description: Returns a message that a chart placed outside allowed contexts is ignored.

methods.name: ImageNotFound
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that a specified image could not be found.

methods.name: ImageNotReadable
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that an image could not be read, including an inner exception message.

methods.name: ImageTypeNotSupported
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that the image type is not supported.

methods.name: InvalidNumericFieldFormat
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that the specified format string is invalid for a numeric field.

methods.name: CharacterNotAllowedInDateFormat
methods.description: Returns a message that a specific character is not allowed in a date format string.

methods.name: UpdateField
methods.description: Returns a generic update field message prompting the user to update the field.
